titles.ja: ホリミヤ Hori-san to Miyamura-kun

title.ja: ほんの, ささいなきっかけで.

1.overview: Hori-san lives a double life: trendy, popular girl at school, simple, strong-willed caretaker at home. After a chance encounter with her classmate Miyamura, she finds out that she's not the only one who hides her true self away.
1.summary:
Hori-san lives a double life: trendy, popular girl at school, simple, strong-willed caretaker at home. After a chance encounter with her classmate Miyamura, she finds out that she`s not the only one who hides her true self away.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 顔は, ひとつだけじゃない.
title.en: You Wear More Than One Face
title.x-jat: Kao wa, Hitotsu dake ja Nai.

2.overview: When her mother asks about Miyamura, Hori comes to a frightening realization. Later, the Student Council ropes Hori into extra work, but when conflict arises, it's up to Miyamura to smooth things over.
2.summary:
When her mother asks about Miyamura, Hori comes to a frightening realization. Later, the Student Council ropes Hori into extra work, but when conflict arises, it`s up to Miyamura to smooth things over.
Source: Funimation

3.overview: Miyamura reflects on his past and present. Hori responds to Remi's selfish demand. A heated conversation between Ishikawa and Miyamura ends with a fistfight.
3.summary:
Miyamura reflects on his past and present. Hori responds to Remi`s selfish demand. A heated conversation between Ishikawa and Miyamura ends with a fistfight. 
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 誰も, 誰かが好きなんだ.

4.overview: The student council room becomes a cool hangout. Hori tries to get Miyamura flustered. An old friend brings out a new side of Miyamura. Later, when Hori gets sick, Miyamura comes to her rescue.
4.summary:
The student council room becomes a cool hangout. Hori tries to get Miyamura flustered. An old friend brings out a new side of Miyamura. Later, when Hori gets sick, Miyamura comes to her rescue.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: それは, 言えないこと.
title.en: I Can`t Say It Out Loud

5.overview: A rumor complicates Hori and Miyamura's budding relationship. Kyosuke comes home to roost and instantly takes a liking to Miyamura. Sakura evaluates her friendship with Remi.
5.summary:
A rumor complicates Hori and Miyamura`s budding relationship. Kyosuke comes home to roost and instantly takes a liking to Miyamura. Sakura evaluates her friendship with Remi.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 今年の夏は, あついから.
title.en: This Summer`s Going to Be a Hot One
title.x-jat: Kotoshi no Natsu wa, Atsui kara.

6.overview: Miyamura ends up staying the night. Rumors spread like wildfire at school. Shindo calls the couple over to share a bag of candy. A second-year girl begins to stalk Miyamura.
6.summary:
Miyamura ends up staying the night. Rumors spread like wildfire at school. Shindo calls the couple over to share a bag of candy. A second-year girl begins to stalk Miyamura.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 君がいて, 僕がいて.
title.x-jat: Kimi ga Ite, Boku ga Ite.

7.overview: Sakura finds the courage to get closer to Toru. Yoshikawa struggles to voice what she truly wants. Miyamura goes away for a week-long trip. Hori worries about her horror obsession.
7.summary:
Sakura finds the courage to get closer to Toru. Yoshikawa struggles to voice what she truly wants. Miyamura goes away for a week-long trip. Hori worries about her horror obsession.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 偽ることで, 見えるもの.

8.overview: Remi reflects on how she and Sengoku started dating. Miyamura discovers a hidden side of Hori. When Yoshikawa gets asked out, the gang gets Ishikawa to help.
8.summary:
Remi reflects on how she and Sengoku started dating. Miyamura discovers a hidden side of Hori. When Yoshikawa gets asked out, the gang gets Ishikawa to help.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 難しいけど, 無理じゃない.

9.overview: Miyamura runs into some unfriendly faces. Hori tries to get Miyamura to fulfill her darkest desires. Mizouchi's love is unrequited. Tanihara confronts his past with Miyamura.
9.summary:
Miyamura runs into some unfriendly faces. Hori tries to get Miyamura to fulfill her darkest desires. Mizouchi`s love is unrequited. Tanihara confronts his past with Miyamura.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: いつか, 雪が溶けるまで.

10.overview: Hori has an unexpected demand of Miyamura. When Yoshikawa learns her fake relationship with Ishikawa might be coming to an end, she's forced to reflect on her own feelings.
10.summary:
Hori has an unexpected demand of Miyamura. When Yoshikawa learns her fake relationship with Ishikawa might be coming to an end, she`s forced to reflect on her own feelings.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 嫌い嫌いも, ウラがある.
title.x-jat: Kirai Kirai mo, Ura ga Aru.

11.overview: The gang tries to get Yanagi to loosen up. Iura is clueless as to how much he terrifies Sawada. When Iura's sister Motoko is struggling with entrance exams, Iura asks Hori to help.
11.summary:

title.ja: これまでも, そして これからも.
title.x-jat: Kore made mo, Soshite Kore kara mo.

12.overview: Yoshikawa heads over to Ishikawa's house. Christmas brings romantic holiday cheer to all. Hori and Miyamura discuss their future.
12.summary:
Yoshikawa heads over to Ishikawa`s house. Christmas brings romantic holiday cheer to all. Hori and Miyamura discuss their future.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: せめて, この大空を.
title.en: I Would Gift You the Sky

13.overview: As graduation approaches, Miyamura reflects on the past year, an uncertain future, and the new life he's found.
13.summary:
